comparison.objective: Commission and lock a damper versus lay slates in rain-shedding overlap order on two roof faces.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine keyed adjustment and cyclic response evaluation versus multi-object placement with face-dependent ordering.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe repeatable stops with retained collar setting versus correct upper-over-lower lap on each face, scored 0.5 per face. No numeric lap threshold is given.
comparison.reason: Overlap reasoning and slate placement are unrelated to dynamic mechanism tuning and locking.
